description:
single storey second floor rear extension
rear roof terrace
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-18129f4c-7fff-9d2c-af56-61161a7b04a3"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The proposed roof terrace, by reason of its location, scale and detailed design, would result in unacceptable levels of noise, disturbance and overlooking, to the detriment of the living conditions of adjoining residential occupiers. Therefore, it is considered that the proposed roof terrace fails to comply with the requirements set out in policy LP2 (Development and Amenity), policy LP58 (Improving the Environment - Pollution) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020) and Policy D14 (Noise) of The London Plan (2021).</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-75cb3a12-7fff-b4a6-c56c-60350a700a84"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed development, by reason of its inappropriate detailed design, scale, form and siting would comprise an unsympathetic, overbearing and discordant addition, which would harm the character and appearance of the application site, adjoining terrace and wider conservation area. The proposed development fails to meet the requirements of London Plan (2021) policies D1, D3 and D4 and Hackney Local Plan (2020) policies LP1 and LP3 and Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD 2009.</span></span></p>
